from pathlib import Path
import re

inputs_dir = Path('/inputs')
work_readme = Path('/work/README.md')
source_readme = inputs_dir / 'README.md'

# Read protected README bytes exactly as prefix
prefix = source_readme.read_bytes()

# Discover matching files in /inputs: *-*.md, by basename, exclude README.md explicitly
matches = [p for p in inputs_dir.glob('*-*.md') if p.is_file() and p.name != 'README.md']
matches.sort(key=lambda p: p.name)

rows = []
for p in matches:
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    title = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('# '):
            title = line[2:].strip()
            break
    if title is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No level-one heading found in {p}")
    rows.append(f"| [{p.name}](../inputs/{p.name}) | .md | {title} |\n")

append_text = "\n## Reference index\n\n| File | Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n" + ''.join(rows)

# Write final UTF-8 file with exact prefix bytes plus appended section
work_readme.write_bytes(prefix + append_text.encode('utf-8'))

# Validation checks
out = work_readme.read_bytes()
assert out.startswith(prefix), "Output does not preserve /inputs/README.md as prefix"

# Ensure final output structure immediately after prefix
rest = out[len(prefix):].decode('utf-8')
expected_start = "\n## Reference index\n\n| File | Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n"
assert rest.startswith(expected_start), "Appended section header/table preamble mismatch"

# Ensure exactly one row per match and sorted lexicographically
lines = rest.splitlines(keepends=True)
row_lines = lines[5:]  # after blank+heading+blank+2 table lines
assert len(row_lines) == len(matches), f"Row count {len(row_lines)} != matches {len(matches)}"
for i, p in enumerate(matches):
    assert row_lines[i] == rows[i], f"Row mismatch for {p.name}"

# Ensure file ends with single newline after last row and nothing else
assert out.endswith(b'\n'), "Output must end with newline"

print('Updated /work/README.md')
print('Matched files:', [p.name for p in matches])
